events.title: Li Yuan proclaims himself emperor, founding the Tang dynasty
events.description: After the fall of the Sui, Li Yuan took the throne at Chang'an as Emperor Gaozu. The Tang dynasty presided over one of the most brilliant periods of Chinese culture.
events.html: After the fall of the Sui, Li Yuan took the throne at Chang'an as Emperor Gaozu. The Tang dynasty presided over one of the most brilliant periods of Chinese culture.

events.title: United States declares war on Britain
events.description: Madison signed the declaration after Congress narrowly voted for war. The War of 1812 ended in stalemate in 1815, but gave Americans 'The Star-Spangled Banner'.

events.title: Wellington and Blücher defeat Napoleon at Waterloo
events.description: The arrival of Blücher's Prussians broke Napoleon's final assault on Wellington's army near Brussels. Napoleon abdicated four days later and was exiled to St Helena.

events.title: De Gaulle calls on the French to fight on
events.description: Speaking on the BBC from London, General Charles de Gaulle rejected the coming armistice and urged French forces to continue resistance. The appeal founded the Free French movement.

events.title: Carter and Brezhnev sign the SALT II treaty
events.description: The treaty capped each side's strategic nuclear launchers. The US Senate never ratified it after the Soviet invasion of Afghanistan, though both sides largely observed its limits.
